# Navigation

## Path-following architecture

::: {.navigation-architecture-slide}

![](img/06_navigation/path_following_architecture.svg){.path-following-architecture-diagram}

Path matching locates the robot on the selected trajectory. Path following then computes a mobile-base command from the path-relative state and sends it through the command multiplexer, where it can coexist with teleoperation and other command sources.

:::

## Path matching configuration

::: {.columns .config-slide}
::: {.column width="48%"}

#### Configuration files

::: {.config-path}

```text
config/
  robot/
    path_matching.yaml
  paths/
    cezeaux_slam1.traj
```

:::

```yaml
path: cezeaux_slam1.traj
prediction_time_horizon: 1.0
path_frame_id: map
autoconfigure: true
autostart: true
display: true
```

:::

::: {.column width="52%"}

#### Configurable fields

::: {.config-table}

| Field | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `path` | Selects a file from `config/paths` |
| `prediction_time_horizon` | Projects the robot state forward |
| `path_frame_id` | Frame used for markers |
| `autoconfigure` | Configures the lifecycle node |
| `autostart` | Starts matching automatically |
| `display` | Publishes trajectory markers |

:::

#### Supported trajectory formats

::: {.config-table}

| Version | Representation |
| --- | --- |
| `2` | Continuous sampled path with sections and annotations |
| `4` | Agricultural rows and turns: `row_path`, `row_line`, `turn_path` |

:::

::: {.navigation-config-note}
Both formats use the WGS84 origin and local ENU coordinates shared with localisation.
:::

:::
:::

## Path-following configuration

::: {.columns .config-slide .navigation-controller-slide}
::: {.column width="52%"}

#### Configuration file

::: {.config-path}

```text
config/
  robot/
    path_following.yaml
```

:::

::: {.navigation-controller-code}

```yaml
sampling_period: 10.0

longitudinal_control:
  selected: classic
  minimal_linear_speed: 0.3

lateral_control:
  selected: predictive
  predictive:
    gains:
      front_kd: 0.7
      rear_kd: 0.4
    prediction:
      horizon: 10

sliding_observer:
  selected: extended_cinematic
  extended_cinematic:
    gains:
      lateral_deviation: 7.0
      course_deviation: 8.0
    filter_weights:
      lateral_deviation: 0.09
      course_deviation: 0.10
      front_sliding_angle: 0.11
      rear_sliding_angle: 0.12

setpoint:
  desired_linear_speed: 1.0
  desired_lateral_deviation: 0.0
  desired_course_deviation: 0.0

cmd_output:
  message_type: romea_mobile_base_msgs/TwoAxleSteeringCommand
  priority: 10
  rate: 10.0

debug: true
```

:::
:::

::: {.column width="48%"}

#### Controller selection

::: {.config-table}

| Command type | Typical mobile base | Lateral control |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OneAxleSteeringCommand` | Front/rear steering | `classic`, `predictive` |
| `TwoAxleSteeringCommand` | Four-wheel steering | `classic`, `predictive`, `front_rear_decoupled` |
| `SkidSteeringCommand` | Differential/tracks | Backstepping and predictive variants |

:::

#### Sliding observers

::: {.config-table}

| Command type | Available selectors |
| --- | --- |
| One/two axle steering | `none`, `extended_cinematic`, `extended_lyapunov` |
| Skid steering | `none`, `picard_skid_backstepping`, `picard_skid_lyapunov` |

:::

#### Key settings

::: {.config-table}

| Section | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `longitudinal_control` | Selects speed control |
| `lateral_control` | Selects steering control and gains |
| `setpoint` | Desired speed and path deviations |
| `cmd_output/message_type` | Must match the mobile base architecture |
| `cmd_output/priority` | Priority registered in `base/cmd_mux` |
| `cmd_output/rate` | Command publication rate |

:::
:::
:::

## Navigation launch flow

::: {.navigation-flow-slide}

![](img/06_navigation/navigation_launch_flow.svg){.navigation-flow-diagram}

`robot_path_following.launch.py` resolves the trajectory, matching parameters,
controller configuration and command type selected for the mobile base. It
starts the ROMEA matching and path-following nodes; filtered localisation feeds
the matcher, while the resulting command is registered with `base/cmd_mux`
before reaching the controller.

:::
